hireCost.title: What your open role costs
hireCost.daysNow: Days it takes you to fill now
hireCost.daysTarget: Days you could get it to
hireCost.perDay: Each day the seat is empty
hireCost.note: A rough floor: each day is valued at the role's salary for that day. It leaves out the candidates you lose while you wait, which usually cost more.

noticeBuyout.title: When your notice ends, and what leaving early costs
noticeBuyout.note: Counts calendar days and a month's pay over 30. Your employer's policy decides the real formula, whether it's basic or gross pay, and whether a buyout is allowed at all.
